news.originalTitle: چرا میلدنهال برای نیروی هوایی آمریکا اهمیتی حیاتی پیدا کرد؟
news.title: چرا میلدنهال برای نیروی هوایی آمریکا اهمیتی حیاتی پیدا کرد؟
news.originalSummary:
۷۵ سال است که در حاشیه یک شهر کوچک بازاری در سافک، تکه‌ای از آمریکا وجود دارد.

پایگاه میلدنهال کارش را در دهه ۱۹۳۰ و در طول جنگ جهانی دوم به عنوان پایگاه بمب‌افکن‌های بریتانیایی آغاز کرد و سپس در سال ۱۹۵۱ به مرکز عملیات آمریکا در اروپا تبدیل شد.

ساکنان غرب سافک به دیدن هواپیماهای غول‌پیکر و شنیدن صدایشان عادت دارند. پایگاه لیکن‌هیث هم که ارتش آمریکا از آن استفاده می‌کند، فقط ۸/۸ کیلومتر با میلدن

دوشنبه گزارش‌هایی منتشر شد مبنی بر این که تقریبا همه هواپیماها به دلیل تهدید ادعایی از سوی ایران پایگاه میلدنهال را ترک کرده‌اند. اما این پایگاه چه اهمیتی دارد؟

منبع تصویر، Shaun Whitmore/BBC

این پایگاه در حاشیه شهر بازاری میلدنهال در سافک قرار دارد و هرچند زمین این پایگاه متعلق به وزارت دفاع بریتانیاست، نیروی هوایی آمریکا آن را اداره می‌کند.

حدود ۳ هزار نیروی نظامی در این پایگاه مستقرند که در حدود ۱۳۰ کیلومتری شمال لندن قرار دارد.

نیروی هوایی آمریکا در بریتانیا پایگاه‌های دیگری هم دارد؛ از جمله پایگاه لیکن‌هیث، که آن هم در سافک است و یگان جنگنده چهل‌وهشتم با جت‌های اف-۱۵ و اف-۳۵ در آن مستقر است، و پایگاه فیرفورد در گلاسترشر که هواپیماهای دوربرد آمریکایی مرتب در آن مستقر می‌شوند.

پایگاه فیرفورد در ماه سپتامبر هدف توطئه‌ای بود که گفته می‌شود با ایران مرتبط بوده است.

وزارت دفاع بریتانیا و نیروی هوایی آمریکا تایید نکرده‌اند که چرا هواپیماها را از پایگاه میلدنهال خارج کرده‌اند.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

بخش راستی‌آزمایی بی‌بی‌سی با استفاده از فلایت‌رادار۲۴، سایت عمومی ردیابی پروازها، توانست ببیند که در طول روز دوشنبه ۱۰ هواپیمای سوخت‌رسان کی‌سی-۱۳۵ نیروی هوایی آمریکا میلدنهال را ترک کردند.

دو هواپیما که صبح دوشنبه از این پایگاه بلند شدند، ابتدا به پایگاه‌های آمریکا در آلمان و ایتالیا رفتند.

اولین کی‌سی-۱۳۵ به پایگاه هوایی اشپانگدالم در جنوب غرب آلمان رفت و پس از چند دور چرخیدن در آسمان، اواخر صبح به میلدنهال برگشت. حدود ساعت ۱۲:۴۵ دوباره به سمت شرق پرواز کرد و در اشپانگدالم فرود آمد.

هواپیمای دیگر در طول صبح در حال چرخیدن بر فراز پایگاه هوایی آویانو در شمال شرق ایتالیا دیده شد و سپس به اشپانگدالم رفت و آنجا فرود آمد. بازگشت هیچ‌کدام از این دو هواپیما به میلدنهال ردیابی نشد.

اواخر همان روز، کی‌سی-۱۳۵های بیشتری از میلدنهال بلند شدند. دو هواپیما به اشپانگدالم، یکی به پایگاه آمریکا در رامشتاین آلمان و چهار هواپیما به پایگاه هوایی مورون در جنوب اسپانیا رفتند.

یکی از هواپیماها که متعلق به گارد ملی هوایی نبراسکا در آمریکاست، به فرودگاه پرستویک در ایرشر رفت. روشن نیست که این توقف از پیش برنامه‌ریزی شده بود تا جت پس از آن به پایگاه اصلی‌اش برگردد یا نه.

منبع تصویر، Shaun Whitmore/BBC

سیاستمداران محلی پس از گزارش‌ها درباره تهدید علیه پایگاه میلدنهال، خواستار شفافیت بیشتر شده‌اند.

ایان شیپ، عضو شورای شهر میلدنهال، گفت: «امروز صبح چند نفر با من تماس گرفتند... نگران هستند. می‌خواهند بدانند چه خبر است. گمانه‌زنی زیاد است و شایعه‌های زیادی در شبکه‌های اجتماعی دست‌به‌دست می‌شود.»

«فکر می‌کنم فقط باید احتیاط کنند و ما هم به توصیه‌ها و راهنمایی‌های روشنی درباره اتفاقی که در جریان است نیاز داریم. امنیت مردم این منطقه از همه چیز مهم‌تر است.»

منبع تصویر، Shaun Whitmore/BBC

نیک تیموتی، نماینده غرب سافک در پارلمان، گفت «در حال حاضر اطلاعات بسیار محدودی منتشر می‌شود»، ولی بر اساس گزارش‌هایی که دیده، معتقدست تهدید گسترده‌تری متوجه مردم منطقه نیست: «می‌دانیم که این پایگاه مدتی است در بالاترین سطح تهدید فعالیت می‌کند. می‌دانیم که ایران و روسیه انواع زیرساخت‌ها در بریتانیا، از جمله سایت‌های نظامی بریتانیا و آمریکا را هدف گرفته‌اند.»

او از مردم خواست «هوشیار بمانند» و هر چیز مشکوکی را به مقام‌ها گزارش دهند.

با این حال، او وزارت دفاع بریتانیا و نیروی هوایی آمریکا را هم تشویق کرد که در چارچوب محدودیت‌های امنیت ملی، «تا حد امکان آزادانه اطلاع‌رسانی کنند».

راجر اسمیت، تحلیلگر هوانوردی نظامی از لوستافت در سافک، هواپیماهای این پایگاه را ردیابی کرده است: «به نظر می‌رسد هر چیزی که قابلیت پرواز داشته، رفته است.»

او به بی‌بی‌سی گفت که خروج هواپیماها از این پایگاه دوشنبه «با عجله» آغاز شد و در طول روز ادامه داشت.

او درباره پایگاه میلدنهال گفت: «به نظر می‌رسد تقریبا خالی شده است. همه گیج شده بودند که چرا ناگهان هواپیماها را از این پایگاه به جای دیگری می‌فرستند و چرا به نظر می‌رسد در لیکنهیث هیچ اتفاقی نمی‌افتد.»

این پایگاه در سال ۱۹۳۴ به عنوان پایگاه بمب‌افکن‌های نیروی هوایی سلطنتی بریتانیا افتتاح شد و پیش از آنکه نیروی هوایی آمریکا در سال ۱۹۵۱ در آن مستقر شود، در جنگ جهانی دوم نقشی کلیدی داشت.

جورج پنجم، پادشاه بریتانیا، این پایگاه را در اکتبر ۱۹۳۴ به طور رسمی افتتاح کرد؛ هم‌زمان با مسابقه هوایی انگلستان تا استرالیا که باشگاه سلطنتی هوانوردی برگزار کرده بود و در آن ۲۰ هواپیما از میلدنهال تا ملبورن با هم مسابقه دادند.

در سال ۱۹۳۹، کمتر از شش ساعت پس از اعلام رسمی جنگ با آلمان، بمب‌افکن‌ها از پایگاه میلدنهال به پرواز درآمدند.

در بقیه سال‌های جنگ جهانی دوم، هواپیماهایی از جمله بمب‌افکن‌های لنکستر، استرلینگ و ولینگتون از این پایگاه پرواز می‌کردند.

این هواپیماها در عملیات حیاتی شرکت داشتند؛ از جمله برخی از اولین بمباران‌های شبانه آلمان در سال ۱۹۴۰، حمله به کلن در سال ۱۹۴۲، آخرین حمله بزرگ به برلین و عملیات پیاده شدن نیروهای متفقین در نرماندی در ۶ ژوئن ۱۹۴۴.

آمریکا سال ۱۹۵۱ اداره این پایگاه را به دست گرفت و بمب‌افکن‌های بی-۲۹ و بی-۵۰ را در آن به کار گرفت.

این پایگاه در دهه ۱۹۹۰ با هواپیماهای استراتوتانکر پایگاه اصلی هواپیماهای سوخت‌رسان اروپا تبدیل شد. نیروی هوایی سلطنتی بریتانیا تا سال ۱۹۶۷ در این پایگاه حضور داشت.

از این پایگاه بیشتر برای عملیات سوخت‌رسانی و تعمیر و نگهداری استفاده می‌شود.

این پایگاه محل استقرار یگان صدم سوخت‌رسانی هوایی است؛ تنها یگان سوخت‌رسانی هوایی دائمی آمریکا در اروپا.

بر اساس وب‌سایت پایگاه میلدنهال، هواپیماهای مستقر در آن شامل استراتوتانکرهای کی‌سی-۱۳۵، سی‌وی-۲۲ آسپری، هواپیمای شناسایی آر‌سی-۱۳۵ وی/دبلیو ریوت جوینت و ام‌سی-۱۳۰جی کماندو ۲ است.

از این پایگاه به عنوان محل تجمع هواپیماها و تجهیزاتی که به خاورمیانه فرستاده می‌شوند، استفاده شده است.

در جریان عملیات علیه ایران، هواپیماهای سوخت‌رسان برای پشتیبانی نزدیک‌تر به خط مقدم، «پیشاپیش» به منطقه اعزام شدند.

هواپیماهای حامل رئیس‌جمهورهای آمریکا اغلب برای سوخت‌گیری از پایگاه میلدنهال استفاده کرده‌اند یا در سفرهای رئیس‌جمهور به بریتانیا در این پایگاه فرود آمده‌اند.

علاقه‌مندان به هوانوردی اغلب بیرون دروازه‌های پایگاه جمع می‌شوند.

در سال ۲۰۲۴، پهپادهایی بر فراز پایگاه‌های لیکن‌هیث، میلدن‌هال و فلت‌ول در نورفک دیده شدند و به هشدار امنیتی گسترده‌ای منجر شدند.

بر اساس تحقیقات موسسه بین‌المللی مطالعات راهبردی، اندیشکده‌ای که بر دفاع و امنیت تمرکز دارد، این «وسایل پرنده بدون سرنشین» احتمالا از کشتی‌های تجاری مرتبط با روسیه در دریای شمال به پرواز درآمده بودند.

نیروی هوایی آمریکا در سال ۲۰۲۰ تصمیمی را که بر اساس آن قرار بود پایگاه میلدنهال در سال ۲۰۲۷ بسته شود، لغو کرد.

این پایگاه برای «کارایی عملیاتی» نیروهای آمریکا در اروپا «حیاتی» توصیف شد.

ایان شیپ، عضو شورای شهر میلدنهال، گفت: «امروز صبح چند نفر با من تماس گرفتند... نگران هستند. می‌خواهند بدانند چه خبر است. گمانه‌زنی زیاد است و شایعه‌های زیادی در شبکه‌های اجتماعی دست‌به‌دست می‌شود.»

«فکر می‌کنم فقط باید احتیاط کنند و ما هم به توصیه‌ها و راهنمایی‌های روشنی درباره اتفاقی که در جریان است نیاز داریم. امنیت مردم این منطقه از همه چیز مهم‌تر است.»

منبع تصویر، Shaun Whitmore/BBC

نیک تیموتی، نماینده غرب سافک در پارلمان، گفت «در حال حاضر اطلاعات بسیار محدودی منتشر می‌شود»، ولی بر اساس گزارش‌هایی که دیده، معتقدست تهدید گسترده‌تری متوجه مردم منطقه نیست: «می‌دانیم که این پایگاه مدتی است در بالاترین سطح تهدید فعالیت می‌کند. می‌دانیم که ایران و روسیه انواع زیرساخت‌ها در بریتانیا، از جمله سایت‌های نظامی بریتانیا و آمریکا را هدف گرفته‌اند.»

او از مردم خواست «هوشیار بمانند» و هر چیز مشکوکی را به مقام‌ها گزارش دهند.

با این حال، او وزارت دفاع بریتانیا و نیروی هوایی آمریکا را هم تشویق کرد که در چارچوب محدودیت‌های امنیت ملی، «تا حد امکان آزادانه اطلاع‌رسانی کنند».

راجر اسمیت، تحلیلگر هوانوردی نظامی از لوستافت در سافک، هواپیماهای این پایگاه را ردیابی کرده است: «به نظر می‌رسد هر چیزی که قابلیت پرواز داشته، رفته است.»

او به بی‌بی‌سی گفت که خروج هواپیماها از این پایگاه دوشنبه «با عجله» آغاز شد و در طول روز ادامه داشت.

او درباره پایگاه میلدنهال گفت: «به نظر می‌رسد تقریبا خالی شده است. همه گیج شده بودند که چرا ناگهان هواپیماها را از این پایگاه به جای دیگری می‌فرستند و چرا به نظر می‌رسد در لیکنهیث هیچ اتفاقی نمی‌افتد.»

این پایگاه در سال ۱۹۳۴ به عنوان پایگاه بمب‌افکن‌های نیروی هوایی سلطنتی بریتانیا افتتاح شد و پیش از آنکه نیروی هوایی آمریکا در سال ۱۹۵۱ در آن مستقر شود، در جنگ جهانی دوم نقشی کلیدی داشت.

جورج پنجم، پادشاه بریتانیا، این پایگاه را در اکتبر ۱۹۳۴ به طور رسمی افتتاح کرد؛ هم‌زمان با مسابقه هوایی انگلستان تا استرالیا که باشگاه سلطنتی هوانوردی برگزار کرده بود و در آن ۲۰ هواپیما از میلدنهال تا ملبورن با هم مسابقه دادند.

در سال ۱۹۳۹، کمتر از شش ساعت پس از اعلام رسمی جنگ با آلمان، بمب‌افکن‌ها از پایگاه میلدنهال به پرواز درآمدند.

در بقیه سال‌های جنگ جهانی دوم، هواپیماهایی از جمله بمب‌افکن‌های لنکستر، استرلینگ و ولینگتون از این پایگاه پرواز می‌کردند.

این هواپیماها در عملیات حیاتی شرکت داشتند؛ از جمله برخی از اولین بمباران‌های شبانه آلمان در سال ۱۹۴۰، حمله به کلن در سال ۱۹۴۲، آخرین حمله بزرگ به برلین و عملیات پیاده شدن نیروهای متفقین در نرماندی در ۶ ژوئن ۱۹۴۴.

آمریکا سال ۱۹۵۱ اداره این پایگاه را به دست گرفت و بمب‌افکن‌های بی-۲۹ و بی-۵۰ را در آن به کار گرفت.

این پایگاه در دهه ۱۹۹۰ با هواپیماهای استراتوتانکر پایگاه اصلی هواپیماهای سوخت‌رسان اروپا تبدیل شد. نیروی هوایی سلطنتی بریتانیا تا سال ۱۹۶۷ در این پایگاه حضور داشت.

از این پایگاه بیشتر برای عملیات سوخت‌رسانی و تعمیر و نگهداری استفاده می‌شود.

این پایگاه محل استقرار یگان صدم سوخت‌رسانی هوایی است؛ تنها یگان سوخت‌رسانی هوایی دائمی آمریکا در اروپا.

بر اساس وب‌سایت پایگاه میلدنهال، هواپیماهای مستقر در آن شامل استراتوتانکرهای کی‌سی-۱۳۵، سی‌وی-۲۲ آسپری، هواپیمای شناسایی آر‌سی-۱۳۵ وی/دبلیو ریوت جوینت و ام‌سی-۱۳۰جی کماندو ۲ است.

از این پایگاه به عنوان محل تجمع هواپیماها و تجهیزاتی که به خاورمیانه فرستاده می‌شوند، استفاده شده است.

در جریان عملیات علیه ایران، هواپیماهای سوخت‌رسان برای پشتیبانی نزدیک‌تر به خط مقدم، «پیشاپیش» به منطقه اعزام شدند.

هواپیماهای حامل رئیس‌جمهورهای آمریکا اغلب برای سوخت‌گیری از پایگاه میلدنهال استفاده کرده‌اند یا در سفرهای رئیس‌جمهور به بریتانیا در این پایگاه فرود آمده‌اند.

علاقه‌مندان به هوانوردی اغلب بیرون دروازه‌های پایگاه جمع می‌شوند.

در سال ۲۰۲۴، پهپادهایی بر فراز پایگاه‌های لیکن‌هیث، میلدن‌هال و فلت‌ول در نورفک دیده شدند و به هشدار امنیتی گسترده‌ای منجر شدند.

بر اساس تحقیقات موسسه بین‌المللی مطالعات راهبردی، اندیشکده‌ای که بر دفاع و امنیت تمرکز دارد، این «وسایل پرنده بدون سرنشین» احتمالا از کشتی‌های تجاری مرتبط با روسیه در دریای شمال به پرواز درآمده بودند.

نیروی هوایی آمریکا در سال ۲۰۲۰ تصمیمی را که بر اساس آن قرار بود پایگاه میلدنهال در سال ۲۰۲۷ بسته شود، لغو کرد.

این پایگاه برای «کارایی عملیاتی» نیروهای آمریکا در اروپا «حیاتی» توصیف شد.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

The mom of a black Ole Miss freshman who filmed white co-eds making racist monkey noises and gestures outside of their apartment revealed Wednesday that she hates that one of the students has withdrawn from the campus.

The unidentified parent expressed regret over Alaina Kunes’s decision to terminate her studies at the University of Mississippi — just three months after starting at the Oxford, Miss., university.

“I hate that she withdrew from the school,” the parent told CBS Mornings. “You see what I’m saying, because the course of her life, that’s going to affect her too.

“That’s somebody’s child, so that bothers me because I don’t like to see kids – you know, you just started, these babies, they’re 18. So I hate that for the young people. I wish people [would] be mindful and just think.”

Kunes, an 18-year-old Wisconsin native, cited safety and harassment concerns for dropping out after identifying herself as one of the three white women in the now-viral clip.

However, one of the three freshmen who live in the residence claimed Kunes’ move was right for “her peace and safety.”

“I feel it was like a good option for her,” they said.

Kunes issued a groveling apology via the law firm, Gardiner Koch Weisberg & Wrona, after fessing up to being one of the women involved.

“To the women I offended and to the Ole Miss community, I sincerely apologize,” she said.

A CBS Mornings Exclusive: The University of Mississippi freshmen who captured the viral video of two white students making monkey gestures and sounds outside their apartment door speak out for the first time. The students and one of their mothers tell @Jerickaduncan how they feel… pic.twitter.com/aOPFbUXwAg

“Before the incident on November 6, I never met the women involved and was unaware of their race, however, I recognize my actions were insensitive, inappropriate, and deeply harmful. I would have never intentionally made those noises or gestures toward a person of color.“I have apologized to the women and I pray they will forgive me. I can never truly understand the pain I have caused them and it was never my intention.

“These girls deserve to feel seen and understood and what I did is not a reflection of who I am trying to become.  Over the past several days, my family and I have received death threats and harassment.

“I am grateful for the authorities working to ensure our safety. As I intend to cooperate fully with the University’s investigation, I ask for privacy for my family. I understand the seriousness of this situation and remain committed to taking responsibility and learning from this embarrassing ordeal.”

Kunes is the granddaughter of Gregg Kunes – the owner of Wisconsin-based Kunes Auto Group. The company owns some 50 dealerships across four Midwestern states.

The freshman withdrew from the college less than three months into the fall semester.

The clip, timestamped Nov. 6 at approximately 8:37 p.m., showed two women walking up to the apartment door — with the first beating her chest and making monkey sounds.

A second woman made the same sound toward the camera, while a third walked past. The video sparked widespread outrage after circulating on social media.

The two other students have not been identified but Shawnboda Mead, the vice chancellor for student affairs at the University of Mississippi, branded the clip “deeply troubling, hurtful, and unacceptable.”

She said the behavior “does not reflect our university’s values or the kind of community we strive to be every day.”

Mead said the incident is being actively investigated by the university.

“We are committed to following our established processes to ensure a thorough review while prioritizing the safety and well-being of our campus community,” the statement read.

“Racism and actions that disparage people because of an aspect of their identity have no place in our campus community.”
news.content:
بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. مادر یک دانش آموز اولی سیاهپوست که از همکاران سفیدپوست در حال پخش صداها و حرکات میمون نژادپرستانه در خارج از آپارتمان خود فیلم می گرفت، چهارشنبه فاش کرد که از اینکه یکی از دانش آموزان از دانشگاه خارج شده است متنفر است. والدین ناشناس از تصمیم آلینا کونز برای پایان دادن به تحصیلات خود در دانشگاه میسیس در سه ماه پس از پایان تحصیل در دانشگاه، ابراز پشیمانی کردند. خانم والد به CBS Mornings گفت: «از اینکه او از مدرسه کناره گیری کرده متنفرم. می بینید که من چه می گویم، زیرا روند زندگی او نیز روی او تأثیر می گذارد. «این بچه یک نفر است، به طوری که من را آزار می دهد زیرا دوست ندارم بچه ها را ببینم - می دانید، شما تازه شروع کرده اید، این بچه ها، آنها 18 ساله هستند. بنابراین من از این برای جوانان متنفرم. کاش مردم حواسشان باشد و فقط فکر کنند.» کونز، 18 ساله بومی ویسکانسین، پس از معرفی خود به عنوان یکی از سه زن سفیدپوست در این کلیپ که اکنون ویروسی شده است، نگرانی های ایمنی و آزار و اذیت را برای ترک تحصیل ذکر کرد. با این حال، یکی از سه دانشجوی سال اولی که در این اقامتگاه زندگی می کنند، ادعا کرد که حرکت کونز برای "آرامش و امنیت او" درست بوده است.
آنها گفتند: "من احساس می کنم این گزینه خوبی برای او بود." کونز از طریق شرکت حقوقی Gardiner Koch Weisberg & Wrona عذرخواهی کرد، پس از اینکه ادعا کرد که یکی از زنان درگیر بوده است. او گفت: «از زنانی که به آنها توهین کردم و از جامعه اوله خانم، صمیمانه عذرخواهی می کنم.» اختصاصی CBS Mornings: دانشجویان سال اول دانشگاه می سی سی پی

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

A recent routine aquatic survey in the lower Great Lakes turned up an incredibly rare fish that also happened to be in poor health.

US Fish and Wildlife Service biologists were surveying Oswego Harbor for invasive fish when they caught a bright yellow burbot fish.

Burbots are usually yellowish-brown, green or brown, but coming across one exhibiting xanthochromism, like this one, is extremely rare.

The Lower Great Lakes Fish and Wildlife Conservation Office said it’s a rare biological condition caused by a genetic mutation that suppresses normal pigmentation and produces a yellow-orange appearance.

“Xanthochromism in wild fish is considerably less common than albinism or melanism, making this an especially unusual capture,” the office said.

While the fish’s color also made this a rare find, even more extraordinary is the fact that burbot populations in Oswego Harbor are already low, and the species typically inhabit deeper, cooler waters than those found within the harbor.

The conservation office said the discovery is the first documented detection of a burbot during a fisheries survey in Oswego Harbor, though a few anglers have reported catches.

US Geological Survey (USGS) biologists noted while processing the fish that it was emaciated and in poor health.

Because of the fish’s health and the unexplained factors contributing to the continued suppression of its population, it was sent to the Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine for a health analysis, the office said.

“The discovery could turn out to be lucky for the burbot too; this exceptionally rare fish may provide valuable insight into the health of the species’ populations throughout the basin that can inform management actions,” the conservation office said.

The US Fish and Wildlife Service also highlighted the rare discovery, saying: “While the survey’s primary goal is to detect and track invasive species, the discovery also highlights the broader value of long-term Great Lakes monitoring programs, which help scientists document biodiversity, identify unusual biological occurrences, and better understand ecosystem health.”
news.content: بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. در یک بررسی معمولی اخیر در آبزیان در دریاچه های بزرگ، یک ماهی فوق العاده کمیاب مشخص شد که از نظر سلامتی نیز وضعیت نامناسبی داشت. زیست شناسان خدمات ماهی و حیات وحش ایالات متحده در حال بررسی بندر Oswego برای ماهی های مهاجم بودند که یک ماهی بوربوت زرد روشن را صید کردند. مانند این، بسیار نادر است. اداره حفاظت از ماهی و حیات وحش دریاچه‌های پایین‌تر گفت که این یک وضعیت بیولوژیکی نادر است که توسط یک جهش ژنتیکی ایجاد می‌شود که رنگدانه‌های طبیعی را سرکوب می‌کند و ظاهری زرد مایل به نارنجی ایجاد می‌کند. در حالی که رنگ ماهی نیز این را به یک یافته نادر تبدیل کرده است، اما عجیب‌تر این واقعیت است که جمعیت بوربوت‌ها در بندر اسویگو در حال حاضر کم است و گونه‌ها معمولاً در آب‌های عمیق‌تر و خنک‌تری نسبت به آب‌های موجود در بندر زندگی می‌کنند. زیست شناسان سازمان زمین شناسی ایالات متحده (USGS) هنگام پردازش این ماهی خاطرنشان کردند که این ماهی لاغر و در وضعیت نامناسبی قرار دارد. به دلیل سلامتی ماهی و عوامل غیرقابل توضیحی که در ادامه سرکوب جمعیت آن نقش دارد، این ماهی به کالج دانشگاه کرنل فرستاده شد.

news.originalContent:
Eleven Democrats are absent from a procedural vote that narrowly shelves a House impeachment vote against US defence secretary.

The United States House ⁠of Representatives has blocked an attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in a surprise reprieve for President Donald Trump’s administration as Republicans reel from their midterm election defeat.

The impeachment articles were introduced by Republican Congressman Thomas Massie, but the effort was backed primarily by Democrats. They accuse Hegseth of abuses of power and conducting illegal military operations.

The Republican-led House voted 211-204 on Tuesday to refer the articles back to the House Judiciary Committee, where they could remain indefinitely. The procedural move in effect killed the impeachment drive for the duration of the current Congress’s term, which ends in eight weeks. On January 3, Democrats will take control of the House and Senate.

In a twist, the absence of 11 Democratic lawmakers during the vote proved decisive.

Here’s what to know about the vote to block Hegseth’s impeachment and what could happen next:

The vote was not on whether to impeach Hegseth. It was on whether to refer the articles of impeachment to the Judiciary Committee, where they may be further investigated or amended.

Such procedural moves are often used as stalling tactics. With the current Congress due to conclude soon, the resolution is unlikely to return to the House floor before its term ends.

Massie called the vote “a procedural motion to kill the resolution”.

It narrowly passed 211-204.

Massie was the sole Republican to oppose the measure. The remaining votes fell along party lines with Republicans supporting the measure and Democrats opposing it.

Eighteen representatives were absent from the vote – 11 Democrats and seven Republicans. Had the Democrats shown up and voted with their colleagues, they would have had the numbers to defeat the procedural move, forcing a full House vote on whether to impeach Hegseth as early as this week.

Trump cheered the result of Tuesday’s vote in a social media post, saying the Democrats’ impeachment effort had “miserably FAILED!”

The Democrats absent from the vote were:

The representatives have given varying explanations for why they did not show up.

Strickland, Jackson, Stansbury and Gillen all blamed a traffic delay in Washington, DC.

Pelosi said she was in her home state for a veterans event while Correa said he was in California before undergoing a health procedure. Horsford’s office cited a personal emergency.

Pettersen, who said she helped introduce articles of impeachment against Hegseth in April, said she had been “denied the ability to vote on this motion” without elaborating.

Jackson, Stansbury, Gillen, Strickland, Horsford, Pelosi and Pettersen all said they would have joined their Democratic colleagues in opposing the measure. Jackson and Stansbury also said they had formally recorded their opposition in the Congressional Record although this does not change the official vote count.

There was no immediate comment from Stevens, Brownley or Wilson on their absences.

Stevens previously criticised the Trump administration for launching the war on Iran with Israel and sought more congressional oversight. But days before the US midterm elections on November 3, the Michigan congresswoman, who had lost the Democratic primary for the state’s open Senate seat earlier to Abdul El-Sayed, endorsed Republican candidate Mike Rogers against her own party’s nominee.

Wilson, 83, on Monday attended the groundbreaking for a housing project in Miami-Dade County. Wilson and Brownley, like Stevens, previously opposed Trump’s handling of the war on Iran and demanded the administration seek congressional approval for the fighting.

Democratic politicians and progressive commentators have expressed outrage that poor attendance from Democrats impacted the outcome of the vote.

Congresswoman Sydney Kamlager-Dove from California said: “We knew that this vote was coming, so people should have gotten their raggedy selves up these steps to vote.”

“There is no reason why we should have lost this vote because of attendance issues,” she added.

Senator-elect El-Sayed, responding to a question about the absent Democrats, said: “You should show up and do your job.”

Some pundits pointed the finger at Democratic House leader Hakeem Jeffries, who is expected to become the new speaker of the House in January. They accused him of failing to exert sufficient pressure on party members to defeat the measure.

Political commentator Krystal Ball called the vote “a major Hakeem Jeffries fail”.

“You could have impeached the war criminal Pete Hegseth but Dems didn’t show up to vote,” she said.

Progressive writer Laura Bassett said: “Jeffries didn’t even whip the vote. He told people to ‘vote their conscience’, and 11 members of his caucus didn’t show up. This is why people want a stronger leader.”

Yes. When the new Democratic-controlled Congress convenes in January, they could begin the process again and will be in a stronger position to advance impeachment articles.

Jeffries has said he will consult members about another potential bid to impeach Hegseth next year. “We’ll have that conversation at the appropriate time,” he said.

However, a vote to impeach Hegseth does not necessarily mean he will be removed from office. Impeachment itself means the House has formally brought charges against a federal official, similar to a criminal indictment.

A successful impeachment vote triggers a trial in Congress’s upper chamber, the Senate, on whether to convict.

A conviction, which immediately removes the official from office, requires at least two-thirds support in the Senate. That means Democrats, even with their incoming majority in the chamber next year, would likely need about a dozen Republicans to join them to secure Hegseth’s removal.

Only eight officials – all federal judges – have ever been convicted by the Senate. Trump has been impeached twice – in December ⁠2019 and January 2021 – but the Senate acquitted him on both occasions.

یازده دموکرات در رای گیری رویه ای که با اندکی رای استیضاح علیه وزیر دفاع ایالات متحده متوقف می شود، غایب هستند. مجلس نمایندگان ایالات متحده از تلاش برای استیضاح پیت هگزث وزیر دفاع در یک مهلت غیرمنتظره برای دولت دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور، جلوگیری کرده است، زیرا جمهوری خواهان از شکست خود در انتخابات میان دوره ای دور مانده اند. مقالات استیضاح توسط توماس ماسی، نماینده جمهوری خواه کنگره معرفی شد، اما این تلاش عمدتاً توسط دموکرات ها حمایت شد. آنها هگزت را به سوء استفاده از قدرت و انجام عملیات نظامی غیرقانونی متهم می کنند. مجلس نمایندگان تحت رهبری جمهوری خواهان روز سه شنبه با 211 رای موافق در برابر 204 رای موافق به ارجاع مجدد این مواد به کمیته قضایی مجلس نمایندگان داد، جایی که می توانند برای مدت نامحدودی باقی بمانند. این اقدام رویه‌ای در واقع باعث از بین رفتن استیضاح در طول دوره کنونی کنگره شد که تا هشت هفته دیگر به پایان می‌رسد. در 3 ژانویه، دموکرات‌ها کنترل مجلس و سنا را در دست خواهند گرفت. در یک چرخش، غیبت 11 قانونگذار دموکرات در طول رای‌گیری تعیین‌کننده بود. در اینجا آنچه باید درباره رای‌گیری برای جلوگیری از استیضاح هگزت بدانید و آنچه ممکن است بعدا اتفاق بیفتد آورده شده است:
رای گیری بر سر استیضاح هگزت نبود. این موضوع در مورد ارجاع مواد استیضاح به کمیته قضایی بود، جایی که ممکن است بررسی یا اصلاح شود. چنین اقدامات رویه ای اغلب به عنوان تاکتیک های متوقف کننده استفاده می شود. با توجه به اینکه کنگره فعلی به زودی به پایان می رسد، بعید است که این قطعنامه قبل از پایان دوره آن به صحن مجلس بازگردد. ماسی این رای را فراخواند.

news.originalContent:
A tech sell-off has raised questions about AI spending and the risks to jobs and growth across the global economy.

Great inventions have often brought a rush of investment. Sometimes, it ends in a crash.

Some experts fear artificial intelligence is heading the same way.

Hundreds of billions of dollars are pouring into AI,  far ahead of the profits it can deliver.

Last week, investors blinked.

The Democratic Party swept the US midterm elections, and some of its candidates had called for tighter rules on data centres that power AI.

Fears of a slower buildout wiped trillions of dollars off stock markets. They have only partly recovered.

The stakes reach far beyond Wall Street. Pensions and growth are riding on the AI boom.

Imagine a country where politicians call for the punishment of anyone who blasphemes against Islam.

A country with candidates for public office who openly call Jews “cockroaches.”

Imagine a country where the police conspire with Islamists to keep Jews out of a major city center.

You’re picturing the United Kingdom.

Not Iran, not Gaza, but Britain — the birthplace of liberty, now cowering under the boot of strident Islam.

To any American who’s unconcerned that radical Muslims and rabid anti-Zionists are conquering your citadels of power, I say look at my country.

Britain is grim proof of how awful things can become when you let Islam and politics fuse into a lethal brew.

I’ve been watching the United States with unease.

There’s the soon-to-be Michigan senator, Abdul El-Sayed, with his familial links to the Muslim Brotherhood.

This is a guy who happily hangs out with Hasan Piker, the rich-boy Twitcher who called Zionism a “mental illness” and said “it doesn’t matter if rapes f–king happened” on Oct. 7.

There’s Ilhan Omar, who has made an art of Islamic self-pity.

Alarm bells should have exploded when she described 9/11 as “some people did something” and said Israel has “hypnotized the world.”

That’s classic Islamo-left bigotry — simultaneously minimizing Islamist terror and defaming the Jewish nation as the octopus-like controller of world affairs.

And of course there’s Zohran Mamdani, the lodestar of the hysterically anti-Zionist left, whose own wife boosted social-media posts celebrating Hamas’ pogrom.

Don’t be blasé about any of this.

Don’t chalk it up to another mad fad on the left.

And don’t write off my warning as nothing but “racist” hysteria.

Many in Britain did just that, and look at us now.

Islamist politics is unavoidable here.

A Labour member of Parliament, Tahir Ali, has demanded laws that would punish anyone who “desecrates” the Koran.

He was pushing at an open door: The Labour government is working on a new definition of “Islamophobia” that will chill public discussion about, or criticism of, Islam.

Brits have lost their jobs for making jokes about Islam.

A schoolteacher has been in hiding for five years after he was hounded by Islamists for showing his students a picture of Muhammad in a classroom chat about free speech.

We already have an Islamic blasphemy law, in spirit if not in letter.

Islamist politicians are increasingly emboldened: This spring, the UK Green Party stood a candidate who called Israelis “Jewish cockroaches,” just months after the party’s deputy leader, Mothin Ali, defended Hamas’ terror as a legitimate “fight back” against “settler colonialists.”

Subscribe to our daily Post Opinion newsletter!

Please provide a valid email.

By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Last month, the Greens adopted a motion saying “Zionism is Racism” that called for the erasure of the Jewish state — a genocidal policy dressed in the rags of woke-speak.

This is a party supported by both Muslims and the keffiyeh kids of the upper middle classes — the same constituencies that cheer for El-Sayed and Mamdani.

Could America’s Democrats go down the same dark road as Britain’s Greens, fully abandoning working people in favor of cozying up to nutters who hate the Jewish state?

I fear they’ve already begun.

The Labour government also panders to Britain’s four million Muslims.

Its war on “Islamophobia” and its cruel sanctions on the Jewish settlements in the West Bank are pure red meat, designed to keep the Muslim vote rolling in.

Our deadly experiment with political Islamism is even being imposed by local law enforcement.

Last year, the West Midlands Police banned fans of the Israeli soccer team Maccabi Tel Aviv from attending a match in Birmingham — under pressure, it later transpired, from local Islamists.

The cops effectively made a British city “Judenfrei.”

Joseph Goebbels would be proud.

But America doesn’t need to follow us.

You can turn things around.

Our mistake is that we bowed to the great lie of our age: that all cultures are equally valid.

We drank the Kool-Aid of multiculturalism, with its lethal drivel about how there’s nothing special about Western civilization, and in fact much that’s wrong with it.

Don’t surrender the wonders of your intellectual and artistic heritage at the altar of cultural appeasement.

All that’s required is a muscular assertion of Western civilization.

You must mount an unabashed defense of the glorious traditions of the American republic against any loser who labels it as corrupt — or “blasphemous.”

The rise of Islamized politics should be met not with fear or fatalism, but with defiance.

We need more people willing to say that the free-thinking, free-speaking Western way of life is morally superior to the Islamist way of life.

That might be scandalously unfashionable, but it’s right.

Brendan O’Neill is chief political writer for the British online magazine spiked.

بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. کشوری را تصور کنید که در آن سیاستمداران خواستار مجازات هر کسی هستند که به اسلام توهین می کند. کشوری با نامزدهای مناصب دولتی که آشکارا یهودیان را "سوسک" خطاب می کنند.
کشوری را تصور کنید که در آن پلیس با اسلام‌گرایان توطئه می‌کند تا یهودیان را از مرکز شهر دور نگه دارد. شما بریتانیا را به تصویر می‌کشید. نه ایران، نه غزه، بلکه بریتانیا - زادگاه آزادی، که اکنون زیر چکمه‌های اسلام خشن فرو رفته است. به هر آمریکایی که نگران نیست مسلمانان رادیکال و ضدصهیونیست‌های خشمگین در حال فتح قلعه‌های قدرت شما هستند، می‌گویم به کشور من نگاه کنید. بریتانیا گواه بدی است که نشان می‌دهد وقتی شما به اسلام اجازه می‌دهید که چه چیزهای وحشتناکی می‌شود و سیاست‌ها متحد می‌شوند. ایالات با ناراحتی عبدالالسید، سناتور میشیگان که به زودی می‌آید، با پیوندهای خانوادگی‌اش با اخوان‌المسلمین وجود دارد. این مردی است که با خوشحالی با حسن پیکر، پسر ثروتمند توییچر که صهیونیسم را «بیماری روانی» می‌خواند و می‌گوید «مهم نیست که تجاوز جنسی در او اتفاق افتاده باشد، می‌گذرد». هنر خودسوزی اسلامی زنگ خطر باید زمانی منفجر می شد که او 11 سپتامبر را اینگونه توصیف کرد که "برخی افراد کاری انجام دادند" و گفت که اسرائیل "جهان را هیپنوتیزم کرده است".
این تعصب کلاسیک چپ-اسلامی است - به طور همزمان ترور اسلام گرایان را به حداقل می رساند و ملت یهود را به عنوان اختاپوس کنترل کننده امور جهانی بدنام می کند.

news.originalContent:
The UK says it will defend its interests at the Law of the Sea Tribunal hearing, as Argentina seeks measures to block the offshore project.

The United Kingdom has pledged to defend its interests in the Sea Lion project to develop an oilfield near the Falkland Islands, as Argentina has brought a legal challenge before a tribunal over the offshore oil exploration, citing environmental concerns.

Attorney General Ellie Reeves, representing the UK government at the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS), said billions of pounds crucial to the future of the Falkland Islands will be lost if Argentina is successful in getting the project blocked.

The Hamburg-based tribunal is sitting for two days as Argentina seeks a provisional ruling to suspend oil drilling.

Reeves also said Argentina’s objection to the development was rooted in its territorial claims. “The hearing is not about the sovereignty of the Falklands,” the UK prime minister’s official spokesman said on Monday, echoing his country’s position that the island’s sovereignty is not up for negotiation.

The dispute is the latest in rising tensions between the UK and Argentina over the British overseas territory in the South Atlantic Ocean.

The Sea Lion development is a UK-Israeli venture to drill for oil in waters administered by the Falklands.

The UK’s Rockhopper Exploration and Israel’s Navitas Petroleum, operator of the Sea Lion oilfield, located about 220km (137 miles) from the islands, are expected to start the project in March 2027, with oil production to begin in 2028.

According to Rockhopper Exploration, the Sea Lion exploration field holds an estimated 1.7 billion barrels of oil in place, of which 500 million barrels are recoverable resources.

However, Argentina’s President Javier Milei announced measures to block the development in September and said in a post on X that he had instructed the Foreign Ministry and the country’s legal teams to initiate arbitration proceedings against the UK.

“If in 2 weeks the United Kingdom does not halt the illegitimate exploitation, we will go to the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea. THE MALVINAS ARE ARGENTINA’s, and they are defended with facts, not words,” he wrote, using the Argentinian name for the Falkland Islands.

Argentina formally filed a complaint at the Tribunal seeking provisional measures against the UK on October 13.

The UK has administered the Falkland Islands since 1833. However, as the territory lies off Argentina’s shores, Buenos Aires claims sovereignty over what it calls Las Malvinas.

Milei has also threatened tougher sanctions on companies involved in the oil exploration project, preventing them from operating in Argentina’s oil and mining sectors.

Milei’s government argues the project violates a United Nations resolution calling on both sides to refrain from unilateral actions in the islands until their dispute over the territory’s sovereignty is resolved.

On Tuesday, Reeves told the Law of the Sea Tribunal, which issues legally binding rulings on maritime disputes, that Argentina wanted to “take control of those resources for itself”.

“The provisional measures sought by Argentina would prevent the people of the Falkland Islands from developing their natural resources as they are entitled to do so, pursuant to their fundamental right to self-determination,” she said, according to The Guardian.

“The measures sought would have devastating consequences for the Falklands people. They risk losing billions of pounds in money, which is essential for the islands’ economic development.”

But Argentina’s lawyer, Mario Oyarzabal, argued that action was needed to block the project.

“[Argentina] respects the interests of the inhabitants of the islands and their way of life as enshrined in the Argentine constitution…What these British citizens do not have is a right to decide to which state the islands belong,” he said during the hearing, The Guardian reported.

“These resources belong to the Argentine people. Some 46 million of them, including the 1,247 inhabitants born on the islands, whose interests will be duly taken into account,” he added.

In 2013, Falkland islanders voted overwhelmingly to remain with the United Kingdom, despite Argentina’s claims.

On Monday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s official spokesperson told the Independent news outlet that the UK was “fully engaged in the UNCLOS [UN Convention on the Law of the Sea] process, and we’ll clearly set out our position on Argentina’s request for provisional measures before the Tribunal”.

“We’ll continue to robustly defend our interests and those of the Falkland Islanders,” the spokesperson added.

Last month, Burnham also discussed the bid to block the oil project during a call with United States President Donald Trump.

“The prime minister raised the economic consequences of Argentina’s coercive measures for the UK and US and reiterated the importance of respecting the islanders’ right to develop their natural resources,” Burnham’s office said.

The fraught relationship between the UK and Argentina remains tense and heavily focused on the Falkland Islands.

Milei has capitalised on Trump’s refusal to say whether Washington would support the UK in a future conflict over the Falklands after the US president criticised London for not doing more to support the US during its attacks on Iran.

In September, Milei said the “winds of change” were blowing in Argentina’s favour when it comes to its claims of sovereignty.

“The United States is considering this change in position because it knows that Argentina has a reliable partner, aligned with Western values, in a strategically important position that can be a valuable ally in the decades to come,” Milei said.

At the same time, Argentina is set for an election next year, where the Sea Lion project’s halt could help Milei’s polling position.

news.originalContent:
Strike disrupts public transport as housing reform takes centre stage ahead of the November 29 national elections.

Millions of workers across Spain are striking to demand government action over the country’s housing crisis, less than three weeks before a national election that could bring the far right to power.

The 24-hour walkout, which began at midnight on Wednesday, disrupted public transport and forced businesses, factories and shops to scale back operations or close entirely across the eurozone’s fourth-largest economy. It’s Spain’s first general strike in 14 years.

Minor incidents were reported in the first hours, including roadblocks with burning tyres in Barcelona, the second-largest city in the country. There were also scuffles between picketers and police near the country’s main wholesale market on the outskirts of the capital, Madrid.

The two main unions calling for the strike, UGT and CCOO, reported widespread participation in the early hours “with significant work stoppages in strategic sectors”, including 90 percent in the automotive and port sectors, according to a statement posted on social media.

The average rent in Spain has almost doubled over the past 10 years, eating into household budgets and angering voters.

The trigger for a wave of mass protests was the forced eviction in September of Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old woman from Madrid who died a few days later. Housing activists leveraged the uproar over Maricarmen’s eviction to call for the general strike.

Spain’s socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called a snap election for November 29 after his minority government failed to secure parliamentary approval for a package of housing measures proposed in response to the protests.

“This is not a strike against anyone, but rather one in favour of a common response from all levels of government to a real problem, which is access to housing,” he said in an interview published Sunday in the daily newspaper La Vanguardia.

The strike has been rejected by business groups, which have described it as an election-related protest, and criticised by the conservative opposition Popular Party (PP) and far-right Vox.

PP leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo warned that unions risked being linked to Sanchez “forever” if they went ahead with the strike in the run-up to the election.

Feijoo, whose party leads opinion polls, said going ahead with the strike was a “serious mistake” following a high-speed train collision last month in central Spain that killed 69 people.

Spain’s average gross monthly salary is about 2,460 euros, while renting a 50-square-metre apartment in Madrid cost an average of 1,170 euros a month in October, according to property portal Idealista.

That amounts to nearly half the average gross salary, and 98.7 percent of the average young person’s income, according to the Youth Council of Spain. It’s well above the 30 percent share commonly recommended by housing experts and public institutions.
news.content: اعتصاب حمل‌ونقل عمومی را مختل می‌کند زیرا اصلاحات مسکن پیش از انتخابات ملی 29 نوامبر در کانون توجه قرار گرفته است. میلیون‌ها کارگر در سراسر اسپانیا دست به اعتصاب می‌زنند تا خواستار اقدام دولت در مورد بحران مسکن در این کشور شوند، کمتر از سه هفته قبل از برگزاری انتخابات سراسری که می‌تواند جناح راست افراطی را به قدرت برساند. اعتصاب 24 ساعته که از نیمه شب چهارشنبه آغاز شد، حمل و نقل عمومی را مختل کرد و مشاغل، کارخانه ها و مغازه ها را مجبور به کاهش فعالیت یا تعطیلی کامل در سراسر چهارمین اقتصاد بزرگ منطقه یورو کرد. این اولین اعتصاب عمومی اسپانیا در 14 سال گذشته است. حوادث جزئی در اولین ساعات گزارش شد، از جمله مسدود شدن جاده ها با لاستیک های سوخته در بارسلون، دومین شهر بزرگ این کشور. همچنین درگیری‌هایی بین جمع‌آوران و پلیس در نزدیکی بازار عمده‌فروشی اصلی کشور در حومه مادرید، پایتخت رخ داد. طبق بیانیه‌ای که در رسانه‌های اجتماعی منتشر شد، دو اتحادیه اصلی که خواستار اعتصاب بودند، UGT و CCOO، مشارکت گسترده‌ای را در ساعات اولیه گزارش کردند "با توقف قابل توجه کار در بخش‌های استراتژیک"، از جمله 90 درصد در بخش خودرو و بندر. میانگین اجاره بها در اسپانیا در طول 10 سال گذشته تقریباً دو برابر شده است و به بودجه خانوارها خورده و رأی دهندگان را خشمگین کرده است. محرک موجی از اعتراضات گسترده اخراج اجباری ماریکارمن آباسکال، یک پیرزن 87 ساله از مادرید بود که چند روز بعد درگذشت. فعالان مسکن از غوغای اخراج ماریکارمن برای فراخوانی برای اخراج ماریکارمن استفاده کردند

news.originalContent:
Iran is said to have geo-located Bessent’s $12.5m mansion in Washington, DC, after US media published an aerial view of the property.

United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has recently moved from his home in Washington, DC, to an undisclosed US military ⁠base in the wake of “Iranian threats” to his life.

The New York Times and the Reuters news agency reported the move on Tuesday, citing sources familiar with the matter, but the severity of the threats remained unclear.

Iran has previously denied plotting to attack officials and people on US soil.

Bessent has led a US economic pressure campaign against Iran, dubbed Operation Economic Outcast, since August to try to push Tehran to end attacks on shipping and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

In April, the US announced a blockade on Iranian ports, but Tehran has remained defiant despite the naval siege.

A spokesperson said in a statement emailed to Reuters that “the secretary will not ⁠be deterred by the Iranian regime’s threats and remains committed to executing ⁠Operation Economic Outcast and maintaining the blockade, which together are collapsing Iran’s economy”.

In a memo seen by Reuters late last month, a senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned that Iranian plots against US citizens had reached an advanced stage.

Security ⁠concerns surrounding Bessent increased when The Wall Street Journal published an aerial view of the Georgetown mansion that he bought for $12.5m shortly after his confirmation ⁠as Treasury secretary in January 2025, Reuters said, citing a source familiar with the matter.

The photo allowed Bessent’s home to ⁠be geo-located, and he was relocated to a military base for his safety, the source said, adding: “The news media has an obligation to act responsibly amid growing threats against public officials.”

The New ‌York Times reported that US officials have noted that Iran’s ability to carry out large-scale attacks in the US and other territories overseas is limited. Yet, US national intelligence chief Jay Clayton warned last month that Tehran has “substantially increased” its efforts to target Americans in the Middle East and beyond.

Those efforts include beefing up the targeting of current and former US officials such as Bessent, the Times reported, citing three sources familiar with the matter.

US and Israeli attacks killed top Iranian officials, including the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, early on in their war on Iran.
news.content: گفته می شود که ایران عمارت 12.5 میلیون دلاری بسنت در واشنگتن دی سی را پس از انتشار تصویری هوایی از این ملک، مکان یابی کرده است. اسکات بسنت، وزیر خزانه داری ایالات متحده اخیراً در پی "تهدیدات جانی ایران" از خانه خود در واشنگتن دی سی، به یک پایگاه نظامی نامعلوم آمریکا نقل مکان کرده است. نیویورک تایمز و خبرگزاری رویترز این اقدام را روز سه شنبه به نقل از منابع آگاه گزارش کردند، اما شدت تهدیدها همچنان نامشخص است. ایران قبلا طرح حمله به مقامات و مردم در خاک ایالات متحده را رد کرده است. بسنت از اوت رهبری یک کمپین فشار اقتصادی ایالات متحده علیه ایران موسوم به Operation Economic Outcast را بر عهده داشته است تا تلاش کند تهران را برای پایان دادن به حملات مجدد به کشتی هوروزیت تحت فشار قرار دهد. در ماه آوریل، ایالات متحده محاصره بنادر ایران را اعلام کرد، اما تهران علیرغم محاصره دریایی سرپیچی کرد. یک سخنگوی در بیانیه‌ای که به رویترز ایمیل شد، گفت: «وزیر از تهدیدات رژیم ایران منصرف نخواهد شد و به اجرای عملیات اقتصادی Outcast و حفظ محاصره‌ها که در کنار هم اقتصاد ایران هستند، متعهد می‌ماند». در یادداشتی که اواخر ماه گذشته توسط رویترز مشاهده شد، یک مقام ارشد اطلاعاتی در دولت ترامپ هشدار داد که توطئه‌های ایران علیه شهروندان آمریکایی به مرحله پیشرفته‌ای رسیده است. نگرانی‌های امنیتی پیرامون بسنت زمانی افزایش یافت که وال استریت ژورنال تصویری هوایی از عمارت جورج‌تاون را منتشر کرد که او به قیمت 12.5 میلیون دلار مدت کوتاهی پس از محرمانه‌اش خریداری کرد.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

Placebo frontman Brian Molko lost it with fans last week at his band’s gig in Milan, Italy, with footage of the meltdown now going viral on social media.

The singer, 53, was angered after seeing many concertgoers at his show filming and taking photos from the mosh pit at Unipol Forum, despite the band’s no-camera rule for their 30th anniversary tour.

Indeed, in the lead up to their gigs, Placebo had been displaying pre-show messages asking fans to put away their phones and immerse themselves in the live experience.

“You’ll remember the moment, not the recording,” was the message flashed on screens at arenas. Yet many fans have been sharing clips from the shows, regardless.

After performing their 1996 hit “Teenage Angst” at the Milan gig, Molko addressed the crowd, initially thanking those who had respected their request.

“We’d like to thank you all, well, almost all of you, for putting your phones away. Because in 1996, we didn’t have mobile phones,” he said from the stage while revealing he was suffering from COVID but decided to perform anyway.

“I’m here playing this concert for you, and you can’t put your f–king phone away?”

The rocker became more frustrated when only a few fans lowered their phones following his request, before shouting directly at audience members who continued filming.

“So if you and you and you can’t put your f–king phone away, when I’m up here with COVID-19 — I’m talking to YOU motherf–ker — we are going to start removing people from the f–king audience, do you understand?”

“I’ve been sick for two weeks and I haven’t cancelled a show,” he added.

However, on Monday, the band’s management announced on their Instagram page that Molko has been diagnosed with acute laryngitis and therefore the next two shows were being postponed.

“We are very sorry to announce Placebo’s shows in Munich tonight, Monday 9th November, and Vienna, Tuesday 10th November, have been postponed,” the statement read.

“Brian has been struggling with extreme flu symptoms but has chosen to push on through and continue to perform shows because he didn’t want to disappoint anyone. Yesterday he took a turn for the worse and a doctor was called last night.”

Along with the statement, Molko and bandmate Stefan Olsdal also shared a personal message that read: “We are so sorry for this late postponement and we fully understand the disappointment this will cause all of you who’ve bought tickets. We will do everything we can to reschedule these shows as soon as possible. Thank you very much for your understanding.

“Please keep hold of your tickets and you will be advised directly regarding rescheduled dates or refunds.”

news.content:
پوشش بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. برایان مولکو، خواننده گروه Placebo، هفته گذشته در کنسرت گروهش در میلان، ایتالیا، آن را با طرفداران خود از دست داد، با فیلمی از این فروپاشی که اکنون در رسانه های اجتماعی پخش شده است. این خواننده 53 ساله، پس از دیدن بسیاری از کنسرت کنندگان در نمایش خود در حال فیلمبرداری و عکس گرفتن از موش پیت در سالگرد انجمن قانون 3 تا No3، خشمگین شد. در واقع، قبل از کنسرت‌هایشان، Placebo پیام‌های قبل از نمایش را نشان می‌داد که از طرفداران می‌خواست تلفن‌هایشان را کنار بگذارند و خود را در تجربه زنده غوطه‌ور کنند. پیامی بود که روی صفحه‌نمایش در میدان‌ها فلش شد: «لحظه را به یاد خواهید آورد، نه ضبط را». با این حال بسیاری از طرفداران بدون توجه به این برنامه، کلیپ هایی از این نمایش ها را به اشتراک می گذارند. مولکو پس از اجرای آهنگ 1996 خود "Teenage Angst" در کنسرت میلان، خطاب به جمعیت گفت و در ابتدا از کسانی که به درخواست آنها احترام گذاشتند تشکر کرد. "ما می‌خواهیم از همه شما تشکر کنیم، خوب، تقریباً از همه شما که گوشی‌هایتان را کنار گذاشتید. چون در سال 1996، ما تلفن همراه نداشتیم،" او گفت که او تصمیم گرفت در حالی که از روی صحنه نمایش می‌داد رنج می‌برد. "من اینجا هستم که این کنسرت را برای شما اجرا می کنم، و شما نمی توانید تلفن f-king خود را کنار بگذارید؟"
راکر زمانی که فقط چند نفر از طرفداران به درخواست او گوشی‌های خود را پایین انداختند، قبل از فریاد زدن مستقیم به مخاطبانی که به فیلم‌برداری ادامه دادند، ناامیدتر شد. «بنابراین، اگر شما و شما و شما نمی‌توانید تلفن f-king خود را کنار بگذارید، وقتی من با COVID-19 اینجا هستم - من با شما مادر-کر صحبت می‌کنم - ما

news.originalContent:
Winter weather has continued to wreak havoc in Gaza, with flooding and strong winds.

Damage from Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza has worsened floods caused by heavy rain, which have submerged large areas of the enclave, local officials say.

A deep weather depression has exposed how the catastrophic deterioration of the Strip’s stormwater and sewage networks is causing thousands of tents to be flooded.

Gaza’s infrastructure has been severely damaged by waves of air raids and shelling since the start of the war in October 2023.

Ramadan Rabaa, a Palestinian shop owner, saw floodwaters sweep through his premises in western Gaza City, destroying large quantities of goods and inflicting heavy financial losses on his and his neighbours’ businesses.

When municipal crews arrived at the scene, they could do little to help due to a severe shortage of equipment and machinery.

Rabaa believes that if municipal authorities had sufficient resources, such as water suction trucks, pumps, and bulldozers, his losses could have been minimised, potentially saving his shop along with other businesses, homes and tents that have been inundated.

The rain has submerged or damaged 70,000 tents, affecting approximately 350,000 people, according to Gaza’s Government Media Office. In some displacement camps, water levels reached nearly 1.5 metres.

The impact of the weather is compounded by wartime destruction, with the media office reporting that more than 700km of Gaza’s sewage network has been destroyed.

Within 12 hours of the storm, Gaza’s Civil Defence received more than 2,000 distress calls but could only respond to 218, because of fuel shortages and equipment breakdowns.

Due to the ongoing siege on Gaza and destruction caused by Israel’s war, Gaza City’s municipality currently relies on only one bulldozer, which often breaks down, and two water suction trucks. Most water and sewage pumps are out of service.

“The municipality lost about 85 percent of its fleet of vehicles and heavy equipment during the war, after the Israeli occupation destroyed more than 135 vehicles, mechanisms, and equipment, leaving it with only 15 percent of the total previous fleet,” Husni Muhanna, a spokesman for Gaza City municipality, told Al Jazeera.

“The remaining mechanisms are old and worn out, suffer frequent breakdowns, and require continuous maintenance to keep them operational and provide the minimum level of services to residents and the displaced, so the municipality is forced to seek help from whatever resources are available in the private sector.”

The destruction extends to the drainage networks.

“The occupation destroyed six sewage pumps out of eight in Gaza City, and the municipality has so far been unable to restart more than two pumps, leading to a decline in drainage capacity to about 20 percent at best,” Muhanna said.

This situation has been worsened by the destruction of the stormwater drainage network. Gaza City has lost about 2,800 of the 4,800 drains that existed before the war, heightening the risk of flooding during heavy rain.

Muhanna warned that the challenges in Gaza City are beyond the capacity of municipal crews, with about a million citizens and displaced people concentrated in an area covering less than one third of the city, while 85 percent of infrastructure is damaged.

To address the situation, the municipality and local institutions have prepared an emergency winter plan requiring $1.3m worth of materials and field equipment. But it depends entirely on the flow of funding and supplies, which is being hampered by Israeli restrictions on Gaza.

Jibril Kashko, a businessman from a family specialising in heavy equipment, told Al Jazeera that Gaza City Municipality requested his help during the recent storm, but was limited in the assistance he could provide due to broken equipment and a lack of operational resources.

“What owners of heavy equipment in Gaza face goes beyond usual breakdowns, as they have become unable to obtain the simplest operating supplies, from spare parts, oil and grease, to batteries,” Kashko said.

Ismail al-Thawabta, director general of the Government Media Office, said the enclave requires between 300,000 and 350,000 tents and reinforced plastic tarps, as well as caravans, to replace damaged shelters. Mobile homes which were supposed to enter Gaza as part of the October 2025 ceasefire agreement have been held up on the border.

Gaza also needs 1,000-1,500 water pumps, 300-500 heavy machines such as bulldozers and excavators, and generators to power essential services.

Al-Thawabta said that repeated displacement and the destruction of most homes in Gaza have left large numbers of residents lacking essential supplies to cope with the winter months.

He said 2.2 million winter clothing bags, 5 million heavy blankets, 2 million water and moisture-insulating sponge mattresses, and about 400,000 heaters are needed to help Palestinians in Gaza cope with the bad weather. But the aid entering Gaza remains at a fraction of what the enclave’s 2.3 million population needs, due to the Israeli restrictions.
news.content: به گفته مقامات محلی، آب و هوای زمستانی در غزه با سیل و بادهای شدید ویرانی به بار آورده است. به گفته مقامات محلی، خسارت ناشی از جنگ نسل کشی اسرائیل در غزه، سیل های ناشی از باران شدید را تشدید کرده است که مناطق وسیعی از این منطقه را زیر آب برده است. فروپاشی عمیق آب و هوا نشان داده است که چگونه وخامت فاجعه بار شبکه طوفان ده ها نوار غزه و فاجعه بار است. سیلاب شدن زیرساخت‌های غزه از زمان شروع جنگ در اکتبر 2023 به شدت توسط امواج حملات هوایی و گلوله باران آسیب دیده است. رمضان رابعه، یک مغازه‌دار فلسطینی، شاهد جاری شدن سیلاب در اماکن وی در غرب شهر غزه بود که مقادیر زیادی از کالاها را نابود کرد و خسارات مالی سنگینی به کسب و کارش وارد کرد. هنگامی که خدمه شهرداری به محل حادثه رسیدند، به دلیل کمبود شدید تجهیزات و ماشین آلات نتوانستند کمکی انجام دهند. ربا معتقد است که اگر مقامات شهرداری منابع کافی مانند کامیون های مکش آب، پمپ ها و بولدوزرها را در اختیار داشتند، ممکن بود خسارات وی به حداقل برسد و به طور بالقوه مغازه او همراه با سایر مشاغل، منازل و چادرهایی که زیر آب رفته اند نجات یابد. به گفته دفتر رسانه های دولتی غزه، باران 70000 چادر را زیر آب برده یا آسیب رسانده است و حدود 350000 نفر را تحت تاثیر قرار داده است. در برخی از اردوگاه‌های آوارگان، سطح آب به نزدیک به 1.5 متر رسیده است. تأثیر آب و هوا با ویرانی در زمان جنگ همراه شده است، به طوری که دفتر رسانه‌ها گزارش داده است که بیش از 700 کیلومتر از شبکه فاضلاب غزه از بین رفته است.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

Former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán’s younger brother was taken into police custody on Monday, the new prime minister said, part of a probe into suspected human trafficking and influence peddling committed while the elder Orbán was still in office.

The move was part of a comprehensive push by Prime Minister Péter Magyar’s new government to unearth suspected corruption and abuses of office committed by Orbán’s far-right administration and associated business circles during his 16 years in power.

Magyar, whose center-right Tisza party defeated Orbán in a landslide election in April, has called the effort “Operation Cleansing Fire.”

Several Orbán-era officials, including the former governor of the Central Bank, are already in police detention on suspicion of fraud and corruption crimes.

Hungarian police said in a statement Monday that they made arrests and carried out house searches in four separate locations in and around the capital, Budapest, and had employed the assistance of Hungary’s Counter-Terrorism Center since the presence of firearms was expected at two of the scenes.

The arrest of four individuals was part of a joint investigation by the National Bureau of Investigation and the newly formed National Asset Recovery and Protection Office.

The investigation centers on the alleged use of political connections to arrange expedited work permits for foreign nationals in exchange for lucrative payments.

Police said the four individuals, who are all suspected of “human trafficking committed in a criminal conspiracy for financial gain,” had facilitated Hungarian residence permits for more than 100 Vietnamese nationals in 2024, most of whom had aimed to leave Hungary for countries in Western Europe.

One of the suspects is alleged to have engaged in influence peddling in the acquisition of the residence permits.

Police did not release the names of the suspects, and declined to provide further details on their identities in response to a request by The Associated Press.

But Orbán, who remains the president of his anti-immigration Fidesz party, said that police actions against his brother, Áron Orbán, were politically motivated.

“I am the target; my younger brother is just a means to an end,” he wrote Monday on Facebook. “What is happening in Hungary is not accountability but a settling of scores. … In this dirty game, the aim is to eliminate political opponents and establish a one-party system.”

Photographs published by Hungarian news outlet HVG Monday evening showed the younger Orbán arriving in a police vehicle at a pretrial detention facility in Budapest.

Áron Orbán’s detention was the latest of several high-profile police actions against former officials or other individuals with close ties to the former prime minister.

In October, police detained the former governor of the Hungarian Central Bank, György Matolcsy, for suspected fraud and other crimes.

Matolcsy was one of Orbán’s closest economic allies, and is suspected of misusing funds through a foundation set up in 2014 that was endowed with some $818 million in public assets.

Matolcsy has denied wrongdoing and is still in custody, while an international arrest warrant for his son, Ádám, is still active.

In September, police took into custody two former ministers in Orbán’s government. One is suspected of criminal mismanagement of 17.3 billion forints ($53.6 million) of public funds and the other of accepting more than 12 billion forints ($37.2 million) in bribes and kickbacks. They remain in police custody.

On Monday, Orbán’s Fidesz party added Áron Orbán to a list of “political prisoners” on its website.
news.content: بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. نخست وزیر جدید گفت، برادر کوچکتر نخست وزیر سابق مجارستان، ویکتور اوربان، روز دوشنبه در بازداشت پلیس قرار گرفت، بخشی از تحقیقات مربوط به قاچاق انسان مشکوک و دستفروشی نفوذ در زمانی که اوربان بزرگ هنوز در مقام بود. این اقدام بخشی از فشار همه جانبه دولت جدید نخست وزیر پیتر ماگیار برای کشف فساد مظنون و سوء استفاده از مقام دولتی بود که توسط دولت راست افراطی اوربان و محافل تجاری مرتبط در طول 16 سال قدرت او انجام شده است. ماگیار که حزب راست میانه اش تیزا اوربان را در یک انتخابات قاطع در آوریل شکست داد، این تلاش را "O Fireee" نامید. چندین مقام از دوران اوربان، از جمله رئیس سابق بانک مرکزی، به ظن کلاهبرداری و جرایم فساد در بازداشت پلیس هستند. پلیس مجارستان روز دوشنبه در بیانیه‌ای اعلام کرد که بازداشت‌ها و بازرسی خانه‌های خود را در چهار مکان جداگانه در بوداپست و اطراف آن انجام داده است و از کمک مرکز مبارزه با تروریسم مجارستان استفاده کرده است زیرا انتظار می‌رفت سلاح گرم در دو صحنه وجود داشته باشد. دستگیری چهار نفر بخشی از تحقیقات مشترک اداره تحقیقات ملی و اداره تازه تاسیس بازیابی و حفاظت دارایی های ملی بود. تحقیقات بر استفاده ادعایی از ارتباطات سیاسی برای ترتیب دادن مجوزهای کار سریع برای اتباع خارجی در ازای پرداخت های سودآور متمرکز است. پلیس.

news.originalContent:
Fatima Sana ‘dreams of a time’ when the men’s and women’s cricket teams are treated as equals.

Pakistan cricket captain Fatima Sana has called for parity between the country’s men’s and women’s teams, urging fans to show greater support for female players by filling stadiums for their tournaments.

The 25-year-old says she “dreams of a time” when the Pakistan women’s cricket team are treated as equal to the men’s team. “I hope it comes,” Sana said on Tuesday.

Sana, who has led the Pakistan team since 2024, is one of the country’s finest cricketers and has swiftly risen to the top echelons of women’s cricket.

The all-rounder is playing franchise cricket for the Australian Perth Scorchers in the Women’s Big Bash League (WBBL) in Australia, one of the world’s top women’s cricket competitions.

Following her team’s six-wicket win over Melbourne Stars on Sunday, Sana was asked about the state of women’s cricket in Pakistan.

“If you look at world cricket, the sport is growing,” Sana told digital cricket news platform CricBlog TV.

“I would like to see the same growth in Pakistan, be it in the men’s or women’s game.”

The right-arm medium-fast bowler is the second Pakistani player to feature in the WBBL after former captain Nida Dar, who played for Sydney Thunder in 2019.

Sana, who holds the world record for the fastest international 50 in women’s T20 cricket, led Pakistan to a bronze medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

“The way the crowds turn up for men’s matches, I hope the same happens for the women’s matches,” she added.

Since making her WBBL debut on October 31, Sana has picked up five wickets in as many matches, with a bowling economy of 7.62 runs per over – figures that keep her joint-10th in the most-wickets chart.

Her WBBL campaign marks just the second time the 25-year-old has featured in an overseas league, having also played for Birmingham Phoenix in The Hundred in England.

“It is an honour to come here and have the opportunity to play [in Australia]. It’s great to play alongside my teammates; they’re very supportive and helpful,” Sana said.

“Personally, I wish for more and more girls from Pakistan to come and play in Australia so that cricket can grow back home in Pakistan, too,” she added.

At Perth Scorchers, Sana shares the dressing room with some of the world’s best players, including ex-New Zealand captain Sophie Devine and Australia batter Beth Mooney.

Pakistan will host the next edition of the women’s T20 World Cup in 2028. It will also be the first to feature 12 teams, up from 10 in the previous six editions.

It will be the first ICC women’s event held in Pakistan, which has hosted two ICC Men’s ODI World Cups and the ICC Men’s Champions Trophy in 2025.

Sana believes the tournament could help boost women’s participation in the sport in the cricket-mad South Asian nation.

“It’s a great step by the ICC that the [2028] World Cup is taking place in Pakistan, which will encourage more women players to come forward,” Sana said.

“When more girls watch the World Cup at home, their parents will also offer them more opportunities to play the sport.”
news.content: فاطمه سانا «رویای زمانی می‌بیند» که در آن تیم‌های کریکت مردان و زنان برابر باشند. کاپیتان کریکت پاکستان، فاطمه سانا، خواستار برابری تیم‌های مردان و زنان این کشور شده است و از هواداران می‌خواهد که با پر کردن استادیوم‌ها برای مسابقات خود، حمایت بیشتری از بازیکنان زن نشان دهند. با تیم مردان برابر تلقی می شوند. سانا روز سه‌شنبه گفت: «امیدوارم این اتفاق بیفتد. سانا که از سال 2024 تیم پاکستان را رهبری کرده است، یکی از بهترین کریکت‌بازان کشور است و به سرعت به رده‌های بالای کریکت زنان صعود کرده است. این بازیکن همه‌جانبه در حال بازی کریکت فرنچایز برای پرث اسکورشرز استرالیا در لیگ برتر زنان استرالیا است. مسابقات کریکت بانوان پس از پیروزی شش ویکت تیمش مقابل ملبورن استارز در روز یکشنبه، از ثنا در مورد وضعیت کریکت زنان در پاکستان سوال شد. سانا به پلتفرم خبری دیجیتال کریکت کریکت CricBlog TV گفت: "اگر به کریکت جهانی نگاه کنید، این ورزش در حال رشد است." بولر بازوی راست متوسط سریع دومین بازیکن پاکستانی است که پس از کاپیتان سابق نیدا دار که در سال 2019 برای سیدنی تاندر بازی کرد، دومین بازیکن پاکستانی است که در WBBL حضور یافته است. سانا که رکورد جهانی سریعترین 50 بین المللی در کریکت T20 زنان را دارد، پاکستان را به مدال برنز در بازی های آسیایی 2026 Airoya-The 2026 رساند. برای m مردان

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

Sen. Bernie Sanders said Tuesday he would not be supporting Sen. Chuck Schumer as the Democratic majority leader in the new Congress, setting up a seismic confrontation after the party’s sweep to power in the midterm elections.

Sanders was joined by Democratic Sen. Elissa Slotkin of Michigan at a news conference at the Capitol, and together they said there needs to be a new generation of leadership and a vigorous debate about the party’s direction and future.

A number of incoming Democratic senators have echoed the call, signaling that they would support another candidate over Schumer.

“The time is now for change,” said Sanders, the independent from Vermont and essentially the father of modern progressivism in the US. “And I will not be supporting Chuck to be reelected as the Democratic leader.”

Slotkin, who said she is not actively seeking the job herself, explained that she wants to see potential Senate leaders present a full plan about the priorities for the new majority.

“I’m a no until and unless I see that from anyone,” she said.

The showdown has been building as Democrats marched across the Senate map to flip Republican-held seats far beyond those that were initially competitive, including in Texas, Kansas and South Carolina.

Schumer recruited high-profile candidates that helped secure the majority, including Sen.-elect Sherrod Brown in Ohio and Sen.-elect Roy Cooper in North Carolina.

But his preferred candidates also lost primaries in Michigan and Maine, with the progressive candidates prevailing and then going on to win their general elections.

Democrats, particularly in the party’s progressive wing, have been bombarding congressional offices with phone calls saying it’s time for new leadership. Michigan Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed and other progressives have pushed for Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland as a potential contender.

Van Hollen, who has previously said he is considering a run for president in 2028, is now also considering a run for Senate leader. It is not clear how much backing he would have.

“I am in the process right now of calling my colleagues,” Van Hollen said at a Washington event Tuesday.

Schumer, 75, has shown few signs of stepping aside, especially after he just led his party to power.

New York Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand, chair of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, gave a full throated defense of Schumer on Tuesday, saying “this caucus is grateful for the work of Senator Schumer.”

“I’m confident I will be elected,” Schumer said at the Capitol.

Pressed about his own future in an interview with AP shortly after the party’s election wins, Schumer said he was focused on the year ahead.

“The focus has got to be on getting things done,” he told AP.

While Republicans have been meeting behind closed doors Tuesday to choose their party leaders for the next Congress, the Democrats in the Senate have just begun those conversations ahead of elections expected later this month.
news.content:
پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید.Sen. برنی سندرز روز سه شنبه گفت که از سناتور چاک شومر به عنوان رهبر اکثریت دموکرات در کنگره جدید حمایت نخواهد کرد و پس از به قدرت رسیدن این حزب در انتخابات میان دوره ای، یک تقابل لرزه ای ایجاد کرد. سناتور دموکرات نیز به سندرز پیوست. الیسا اسلاتکین از میشیگان در یک کنفرانس خبری در کاپیتول، و با هم گفتند که باید نسل جدیدی از رهبری و بحثی جدی در مورد مسیر و آینده حزب وجود داشته باشد. تعدادی از سناتورهای دموکرات جدید این درخواست را تکرار کردند و نشان دادند که از نامزد دیگری به جای شومر حمایت خواهند کرد. سندرز، مستقل از ورمونت و اساساً پدر ترقی گرایی مدرن در ایالات متحده، گفت: اکنون زمان تغییر است. و من از چاک برای انتخاب مجدد به عنوان رهبر دموکرات ها حمایت نخواهم کرد.
اسلاتکین، که گفت خودش فعالانه به دنبال این شغل نیست، توضیح داد که می خواهد ببیند رهبران بالقوه سنا طرح کاملی درباره اولویت های اکثریت جدید ارائه می دهند. او گفت: «من تا زمانی که این را از کسی نبینم، نه هستم.» این رویارویی زمانی شکل گرفت که دموکرات‌ها در سراسر نقشه سنا راهپیمایی کردند تا کرسی‌های جمهوری‌خواهان را بسیار فراتر از کرسی‌هایی که در ابتدا رقابتی بودند، از جمله در تگزاس، کانزاس و کارولینای جنوبی برگردانند. شومر نامزدهای برجسته‌ای را به خدمت گرفت که به حفظ اکثریت سنا کمک کردند، از جمله سناتورها. کوپر در کارولینای شمالی. اما کاندیدای مورد علاقه او

news.originalContent:
Former Prime Minister Imran Khan ⁠is taken ⁠to a government hospital in Islamabad for eye treatment and returned to prison.

Islamabad, Pakistan – The party of jailed former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan has demanded access to its leader after he was taken to a hospital overnight for treatment and sent back to prison.

Khan, 74, briefly left the Adiala Jail in Rawalpindi for an eye examination at Islamabad’s Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), the government hospital said on Wednesday.

In a statement, PIMS said a medical check was conducted on Khan on the advice of his ophthalmologist.

Khan has received a series of intravitreal injections in his right eye to treat central retinal vein occlusion (CRVO), a condition diagnosed after he reported reduced vision. He received his first injection in January.

PIMS said Khan received another injection overnight.

“His vital parameters were found to be normal. He was clinically stable, and his general physical examination was normal,” the hospital said, adding that he was discharged about 2:30am (21:30 GMT on Tuesday) with instructions for further care and follow-up.

Khan, a former cricket star who served as premier from 2018 to 2022, has been behind bars since August 2023 on multiple corruption charges he denies and calls politically motivated. The government rejects the allegation.

Khan’s Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party on Wednesday said the overnight hospital visit and his return to his prison cell raise “deeply troubling questions” about his health, the quality of his medical care and the transparency surrounding his condition.

“A human being’s health is not a political bargaining chip. Nor can the medical treatment of a former prime minister be reduced to a procedural formality,” the PTI said, adding that the “state bears full responsibility for his safety and wellbeing”.

“His family, personal doctors and legal team must be given immediate and unrestricted access,” the party said.

PTI information secretary Sheikh Waqas Akram told Al Jazeera that Khan’s family and personal doctors were not told about the hospital visit and the party learned of it from news reports.

“No one from the family or party was there [at the hospital]; our personal physician was not there either,” he said.

During a hearing on Tuesday, Khan’s lawyer Salman Safdar told the Islamabad High Court that while Khan had said his eyesight had improved, his blood pressure remained a concern.

Safdar had appeared on behalf of Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, to appeal against their convictions in a property case.

In response, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry told reporters that Khan was receiving the required medical care and his treatment was not being neglected.

In August, the Supreme Court ordered that Khan should be moved to a private hospital of his choice in Islamabad. Instead, he was taken to PIMS and returned to jail.

A brave Foo Fighters fan became the star of the show at the Foo Fighters stadium gig in Sydney when he bowed to frontman Dave Grohl’s demand to perform the Mentos geyser experiment.

During the rock band’s acoustic set at Tuesday night’s show, Grohl was sharing the long history behind the band’s “Big Me” music video, filmed in Sydney in 1996, which was a parody of a famous commercial by the candy brand.

“I didn’t eat those candies, because after we made this video, people threw those f–king things in my face every night every time we played this song,” he told 60,000 fans at the concert.

Grohl then spotted a fan named Thomas brandishing a packet of the mints in the front rows near the security barrier.

And he was not having Thomas throw the hard sugar bullets at his head.

“Don’t you f–king dare. I’m telling you, don’t be that guy!” the sweary rocker yelled, pointing at the mint man.

“How about this? I’m going to play this song and I want to watch you eat that whole f–king pack of Mentos while I’m playing this goddamn song. Keep the camera on this motherf–ker! If you can finish that whole pack before we’re done playing this song … I’ll chug a beer with you.”

Thomas took up the challenge. Now any citizen scientist, and Dave Grohl, knows that if you drop a Mentos into a carbonated beverage, it causes a sudden explosive eruption of foam.

After emptying the entire cylinder of mints into his mouth, Thomas was projected on the big screens as he spent a couple of minutes chewing the lollies, and then was passed a beer from the stage.

Grohl rewarded the fan by inviting him to watch the show from the pit in front of the stage, brought him up during a later song in the set, and extended an invitation for him to go backstage and meet the band after the concert.

But he knew things might go pear-shaped the longer the Mentos and the beer mingled in the fan’s stomach.

“You know who’s gonna go throw up in my f–king dressing room right now,” Grohl told the crowd. “I’m gonna go back to my dressing room and find Thomas in a pile of puke.

“He just f–king ate a whole pack of Mentos and then chugged a f–king Coors Light.

“It’s like, Wait, hold on, isn’t that that thing if you put those in a Pepsi? Ladies and gentlemen, I’m not even kidding. This might be the funnest show we’ve ever played in this f–king city. For real.”

Two songs later, Grohl struck a sombre note when he made an emotional tribute to Beaconsfield mine collapse survivor Todd Russell, who died on Monday after a battle with leukemia.

Russell and Brant Webb were entombed underground for almost two weeks after the Tasmanian mine collapse in 2006 and requested an iPod filled with Foo Fighters songs to help drown out the sound of drilling as rescuers raced against time to bring them out.

Grohl sent a message of support to them and promised free tickets to any of the band’s shows.

Ahead of a performance at the Sydney Opera House in 2006, he wrote the “Ballad of the Beaconsfield Miners” in his hotel room and honoured a promise to include it on their next record which was the 2007 album, “Echoes, Silences, Patience & Grace.”

“We lost one of the Beaconsfield miners today … I’ve met a few heroes in my life, but that was a big one, so I’m doing this one tonight for Todd Russell,” Grohl said.

While the Foos delivered a blistering set of their greatest hits, the concert was interrupted a few times as fans in the jam-packed area in front of the stage had to be evacuated by medical and security staff.

One fan was taken out of the mosh pit by wheelchair and another via stretcher as the band monitored the situation from the stage, playing “Stairway to Heaven” as they were treated.

The Foo Fighters continue their Take Cover tour this week.
